findings.description: The checker acknowledges that the posted AC1 output omits the required `findings` property, so the comment does not demonstrate the claimed schema-conforming blocked verdict from the live replay.
findings.evidence: Checker-of-record C-6 minor finding: "AC1 code block pretty-printed JSON silently drops `findings` key"; C-6 requires demonstrated, not asserted, acceptance criteria.

findings.description: The claimed humanizer compliance is unsupported and conflicts with the humanizer skill's explicit rules.
findings.evidence: The record reports only regex-style scans and title-cased headings/unspaced em dashes. `humanizer/SKILL.md` requires a formal draft-audit-final loop, final sentence-case headings, and no em/en dashes; it also treats repeated negative parallelisms such as "X rather than Y" as an AI-writing tell. The checker itself records five such constructions without showing the required audit-and-revise loop.

findings.description: The summarized test evidence does not establish that all seven required suites ran successfully.
findings.evidence: The record cites only six pass totals, "29/43/46/30/179/43 passed, 0 failed," although C-1 names seven commands, including `scripts/test_build_plugin.py`; no exit evidence for that seventh suite is supplied.
